name: Pendulum A
description: Small-angle pendulum: linear or nonlinear? The green disk taped in the plane of motion is a US quarter (24.26 mm diameter).

proposal.feasibility_note: Recommend 70° because it is the feasible setting with the largest physical effect (7% difference in the predicted observable) among settings that separate the models by ≥10σ. Expected separation 837.1σ RMS (max 1511σ) after the 0.5 s conditioning window. Larger values were avoided because above ~75° the string can go slack and the bob may leave the frame.
proposal.filming_instructions: Release the same pendulum from 70° (string taut, bob at rest), keep the camera and the reference object exactly where they were, and record at least 6 full swings.
